question.problem: Find the angle between $a=⟨-1,7,0⟩$ and $b=⟨3,6,-1⟩.$ Round your answer to $1$ decimal place.
question.worked_solution:
Rearranging the dot product formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  & =\frac{a\cdot b}{|\,a\,||\,b\,|} \\  & =\frac{{a}_{x}{b}_{x}+{a}_{y}{b}_{y}+{a}_{z}{b}_{z}}{\sqrt{{a}_{x}^{2}+{a}_{y}^{2}+{a}_{z}^{2}}\sqrt{{b}_{x}^{2}+{b}_{y}^{2}+{b}_{z}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{(-1)\cdot 3+7\cdot 6+0\cdot (-1)}{\sqrt{(-1)^{2}+{7}^{2}+{0}^{2}}\sqrt{{3}^{2}+{6}^{2}+(-1)^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{39}{\sqrt{50}\cdot \sqrt{46}} \\  & =\frac{39}{\sqrt{2300}} \\  & =\frac{39}{10\sqrt{23}}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\theta =\operatorname{arccos}⁡(\frac{39}{10\sqrt{23}})≈{35.6}^{∘}.
$$
